subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Does the current head preserve the intended fail-closed security and availability contract across staged-proof publication, credential isolation, durable routing, authenticated requeues, and final mutation guards?
rationale: The PR changes several coupled privileged automation boundaries, and tests alone cannot establish that their combined policy matches maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after boundary review

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing until exact-head evidence and reviewer capacity are available.
